--- Page 1 (Beckerman_34a) --- Dear Folks: Few days have past since I last wrote you. Just a few days before your receive this letter you probably will have heard from Abe. That we have seen each other. It was really a surprise for both of us but more so for Abe. I knew Abe was in Manila but he didn't know I had also arrived. As soon as I found out where he was located, I got hold of a jeep (with a was driver, I still don't know too much about driving) and went out to see him one morning. They told me where his was located at his orderly room. I found him resting in a box his barracks - which, by the way is one of the nicest in Manila. It's a little bit of a bore to think what No [illegible] --- Page 2 (Beckerman_34b) --- 2 place at him — I hardly recognized him. He's taller than I am and much huskier. The main new feature that I couldn't get over, was the change in his voice — completely different from what I remembered as his old manner of speaking. I only was able to stay for a half hour that morning. He showed me the scrapbook Ruth sent him and many photos that I hadn't seen (as well as a copy of the latest Bulletin). However I made an appointment with him the following night at 6:00 PM in town. He lives a few miles out of heart of town and I do too — in the opposite direction. But I work from home and so it was very easy for us to visit just once a week — using a 20 page message service. --- Page 3 (Beckerman_34c) --- the city is free of more army vehicles than I've ever seen. Well that night we walked around the ruins of the city and talked and [illegible]. It's a pleasure to talk to Abe. He's nearly grown-up and matured. Very much different from the boy he was when I saw him last in Sept of 1943. You don't have to worry about his health or job or anything else. He's well and OK. in all respects. He probably will be around here for some time yet so I'll have plenty time to see you. I was [illegible] at his knowledge of all the [illegible] and tactics within the [illegible] I too never told you. but now that it's all over I think it's OK for you to know more of the [illegible] [illegible] for [illegible] campaigns
